title: Minecraft 26.2
description: Minecraft 26.2, also known as Chaos Cubed, introduces the mysterious Sulfur Caves biome, featuring bubbling sulfur pools, sulfur spikes, and the new Sulfur Cube mob. Sulfur Cubes can absorb blocks, changing their physical properties and allowing players to use them in creative ways. The update also adds sulfur and cinnabar building blocks, new music, a Friends List, experimental Vulkan rendering support, and various gameplay improvements and bug fixes.
